commit.message:
Add comprehensive sub-agent architecture with 45 specialized roles

This commit establishes a complete reusable sub-agent template architecture
for building applications using specialized AI agents.

## Key Features

### 1. Leadership & Management (NEW)
- Orchestrator/CEO Agent: Master coordinator for all sub-agents
- Product Manager Agent: Product strategy and requirements

### 2. Complete Role Coverage (45 Roles)
- Leadership & Management: 2 roles
- Design & UX: 4 roles
- Frontend Development: 6 roles
- Backend Development: 7 roles
- Data & AI/ML: 6 roles
- Infrastructure & DevOps: 7 roles
- Quality Assurance & Testing: 5 roles
- Specialized Technical: 8 roles

### 3. Architecture Components
- Modular agent design with clear responsibilities
- Standardized communication protocol
- Workflow orchestration system
- Configuration-based agent definitions
- Comprehensive error handling

### 4. Documentation
- README.md: Project overview and quick start
- ARCHITECTURE.md: Detailed system architecture
- ROLES_REFERENCE.md: Complete reference for all 45 roles

### 5. Agent Configurations
- Agent template with complete schema
- Orchestrator/CEO agent (leadership)
- Product Manager agent (product strategy)
- Solutions Architect agent (architecture verification)
- ML/AI Engineer agent (machine learning)

### 6. Workflows
- Feature development workflow (10-stage end-to-end process)

### 7. Examples
- Simple CRUD app example with detailed workflow

## Technical Highlights

- JSON-based agent configuration
- Standardized input/output schemas
- Quality criteria and validation rules
- Error handling and escalation strategies
- Collaborative agent communication
- Workflow orchestration with dependencies

This architecture enables building complex applications by coordinating
specialized AI agents, each with domain expertise in their respective
technical roles.
